item.title: In Minnesota, US cardinals and pope’s ambassador decry mass deportations and call for reconciliation
item.description: They urged everyone to repair strained relations and work together toward humane solutions.

item.title: Women take over historic Sonoma County bar, want to bring back Cotati Crawl
item.description: Cotati's 89-year-old 8 Ball tavern is now being led by a three-woman team. The new owners have big plans for the bar, including bringing back the famed Cotati Crawl.

item.title: Biden flies commercial from Reagan National Airport and winds up stuck in delays like everyone else
item.description: Former presidents are just like us.

item.title: Trump raises the possibility of a ‘friendly takeover of Cuba’ coming out of talks with Havana
item.description: The president did not offer any details on what he meant.

item.title: A golden sweep by Team USA in Olympic hockey led to celebrations that got complicated and political
item.description: The U.S. swept both Olympic hockey gold medals only to see the celebrations turn into a political flashpoint.

item.title: 2 trans men sue Kansas over a law invalidating their driver’s licenses and about 1,700 others
item.description: The men filed their lawsuit Thursday, the same day the law took effect.

item.title: Pentagon to cut ties with Columbia, Yale, Brown and others Hegseth accuses of ‘wokeness’
item.description: Hegseth said the universities have become “breeding grounds of toxic indoctrination” that undermine military values.

item.title: Federal judge extends order protecting refugees in Minnesota from being arrested and deported
item.description: The order applies only in Minnesota.

item.title: Treasury Department terminates union contracts for IRS and Bureau of the Fiscal Service workers
item.description: Workers at the Bureau of the Fiscal Service are also affected.
